name: tff-bulb
metrics: latency 2 gt, edge rising, min-pulse 1 gt, min-period 2 gt
caption: Copper bulb T flip-flop, 3 blocks (track tff): the input (a redstone block written next to it) powers a waxed copper bulb, which toggles LIT on every rising edge of its power, in the update itself; a comparator on stone reads the bulb (15 / 0) and the output is the cell it points into: latency 2 gt (the comparator), 1 gt pulses accepted, trains down to 2 gt periods followed.

name: tff-observer-piston
metrics: latency 11 gt, edge rising, min-pulse 3 gt, min-period 10 gt
caption: Observer + sticky piston T flip-flop, 4 blocks (found by the tff census): a sticky piston P facing down (powered by the input) has an observer O watching it from the east, and a sticky piston Q two cells east of P's foot faces west at a redstone block R; Q is quasi-connected through the cell O outputs into. Each input pulse makes P extend and retract, so O pulses twice: with R next to Q (output on), Q's first short pulse pushes R under P and spits it there; with R under P, P pushes it down and pulls it back, Q's head reaches out and the second observer pulse pulls R home. Latency 11 gt, pulses of 3 gt and longer, trains down to a 10 gt period; rests ON.

name: tff-snowdisp-dust
metrics: latency 6 gt, edge rising, min-pulse 1 gt, min-period 4 gt
caption: Powder snow dispenser T flip-flop, dust variant, 7 blocks (track tff): the dispenser of tff-snowdisp (each pulse places or picks up powder snow, the dispenser holding a powder snow bucket or an empty bucket); its comparator gives 2 or 1, and two dust decay that to 1 or 0. Latency 6 gt, 1 gt pulses, trains down to 4 gt; rests ON.

name: tff-snowdisp
metrics: latency 6 gt, edge rising, min-pulse 1 gt, min-period 4 gt
caption: Powder snow dispenser T flip-flop, 6 blocks (track tff): each input pulse fires a dispenser facing up; it holds a powder snow bucket (it places powder snow above itself and keeps an empty bucket) or an empty bucket (it picks the powder snow back up). Comparator C reads the dispenser: 2 with the powder snow bucket (stack size 1), 1 with the empty bucket (stack size 16); comparator K feeds C's side a constant 2 read from a dropper holding a powder snow bucket, so C (compare mode) gives 2 or 0. Latency 6 gt (dispenser 4 + comparator 2), 1 gt pulses, trains down to 4 gt; rests ON.

name: d-latch-repeater
caption: Repeater-lock D latch, 4 blocks (track memory census): the data input feeds repeater M (on stone) whose output is q; the enable input feeds a second repeater L pointing into M's side. While L is on M is locked and holds q; while it is off M follows d. Transparent while e is OFF (`enable low`), latency 4 gt.

name: rs-dropper
caption: Dropper RS latch, 4 blocks (track memory): droppers A (facing east) and B (facing west) face each other and hold one stone. s (next to A) fires A and the stone goes to B; r (next to B) fires B and it comes back; firing the empty one does nothing, so repeated s or r change nothing. A comparator on stone reads B: q is its output (1). Latency 6 gt (dropper 4 + comparator 2).
